_about: Retrieval eval set for Palmquay's RAG assistant (fictional company, sample records). Each question names the one file that holds its answer. 'kind' = exact (shares words with the answer) or paraphrase (different words, same meaning; keyword search is expected to struggle). Pass rule, set before the first run (11/18): exact questions recall@3 >= 0.80.
